result.question: According to the word of Yahweh, what would happen to the man of God’s body?

readings.answer: It would never reach the tomb of his fathers.
readings.support: your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers

assessments.reason: The passage says, “your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers,” which is the same meaning as “would not reach the tomb of his fathers.”

result.reason: The text directly states the body would never reach the tomb of his fathers, matching the key.
